title: Pezeshkian: Iran Will Allow UN Nuclear Inspectors to Return
detail: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian announced that Iran will allow UN nuclear inspectors to return, signaling a diplomatic opening amid ongoing tensions over Iran's nuclear program. The move could ease international pressure and potentially revive stalled negotiations.

media.caption: Pezeshkian says Iran will allow UN nuclear inspectors to return

title: Iran Awaits US Response After Trump Rejected Peace Plan
detail: Iran is awaiting a US response after the Wall Street Journal reported that Trump rejected Iran's peace plan. Iran signalled openness to further negotiation, pending a US move, indicating diplomatic channels remain open despite the setback.

title: China Formally Opposes Unilateral Military Actions in US-Iran War
detail: China formally opposed unilateral military actions in the US-Iran war and called for a two-state solution on Palestine, staking out a diplomatic position as the conflict intensifies. Beijing's statement signals growing Chinese involvement in mediating the region's escalating crisis and pushback against the US-led coalition.

title: Iran Warns European Leaders Against Joining US-Led Coalition
detail: Iran issued a direct warning to European leaders against providing military support to Trump's campaign against Iran, threatening consequences if European nations join the US-led coalition. The warning underscores Iran's effort to fracture Western unity and prevent NATO allies from deepening involvement in the conflict.
